title: Docs: use versioned full-URL links for cross-page references
answers: How should I link to another docs page from Grafana documentation?
Why do doc links use https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/<GRAFANA_VERSION>/... instead of relative paths?
What link format passes Vale/Writers' Toolkit review for cross-page links?
body: Cross-page links in docs/sources content use the full versioned URL form, e.g. https://grafana.com/docs/grafana/<GRAFANA_VERSION>/administration/provisioning/#data-sources, rather than relative markdown links. This is required by the Writers' Toolkit links guidance and is what Vale checks at the CI alert level. Use this form when adding any link from one docs/sources page to another.
applies: Editing or adding content under docs/sources/**
